Renal Calculators

Calculators for kidney function, filtration, and fluid balance.

Anion Gap

Calculate the anion gap from serum sodium, chloride, and bicarbonate values.

BMI

Calculate body mass index from height and weight.

Corrected Calcium

Adjust serum calcium for albumin concentration.

eGFR — CKD-EPI 2021 Creatinine

Estimate glomerular filtration rate using the CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation.

eGFR — CKD-EPI Creatinine-Cystatin C

Estimate eGFR using the CKD-EPI combined creatinine and cystatin C equation.

Estimate creatinine clearance using Cockcroft-Gault for drug dosing and renal assessment.

Fractional Excretion of Sodium

Estimate fractional excretion of sodium to distinguish prerenal vs intrinsic renal injury.

Fractional Excretion of Urea

Calculate fractional excretion of urea for patients on diuretics.

BUN/Creatinine Ratio

Calculate the blood urea nitrogen to creatinine ratio for renal function assessment.
